widget.prompt: Show 1 counter for a duck already on the pond. Slide 1 more counter over to join it. What should you do to find how many counters are on the pond?

options.label: Add
options.feedback: Correct — one more counter joining the group means the total grows, so add.

options.label: Subtract
options.feedback: Subtracting would make the group smaller, but this counter is ARRIVING to join.

options.label: Count only the new counter
options.feedback: That leaves out the counter already on the pond before the new one joined.
